desc: Derive DP state definitions: f(u) = best valid subtree containing a degree-4 vertex with u connected to parent (u degree 4 → exactly 3 children); leaf case value 1; h(u) = max(1, f(u)); component-top cases g1 (leaf-top, 1 child with f defined) and g2 (branch-top, 4 children)
Work out transitions and validate on samples 1–3 by hand (8, -1, 11 all reproduced)

Confirm correctness argument: any valid component has a unique highest node w.r.t. root; it is either a leaf-top (1 child, branch below) or branch-top (4 children); decomposition into child subtrees is valid by connectivity
Implement iterative DFS (avoid recursion limits), per-node top-4 tracking in O(deg), fast input via sys.stdin, output answer or -1
Test edge cases: N=1, N<5, pure path (no degree ≥4 → -1), star K1,4 (→5), chained centers; confirm answer ≡ 2 (mod 3) emerges automatically
